definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is within a specified limit.

examples.japanese: {三日|みっか}{以内|いない}に{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: It will arrive within three days.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}から{五分|ごふん}{以内|いない}で{行|い}けます。
examples.english: You can get there within five minutes from the station.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}{以内|いない}でいいものを{探|さが}しているが、なかなか{見|み}つからない。
examples.english: I'm looking for something good within my budget, but I can't find anything.

examples.japanese: {一週間|いっしゅうかん}{以内|いない}にレポートを{出|だ}さなければならないので、{早|はや}く{書|か}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I have to submit the report within one week, so I started writing it early.

examples.japanese: この{病院|びょういん}は{家|いえ}から{歩|ある}いて{十分|じゅっぷん}{以内|いない}のところにあるので、{何|なに}かあった{時|とき}もすぐに{行|い}ける。
examples.english: This hospital is within a ten-minute walk from home, so I can get there quickly if something happens.

notes:
{以内|いない} means 'within' or 'no more than.'

IMPORTANT: {以内|いない} INCLUDES the boundary:
- {三日|みっか}{以内|いない} = within 3 days (includes day 3)
- {百円|ひゃくえん}{以内|いない} = 100 yen or less

Common patterns:
- [number] + [counter] + {以内|いない}: within [number]
- 〜{以内|いない}に: within ~ (with time expressions)
- 〜{以内|いない}で: within ~ (with amount/range)

Related words:
- {以下|いか}: ~ or less (for amounts, rankings)
- {未満|みまん}: less than (excludes boundary)
- {中|なか}: inside (physical space)
